items.title: Vance says Iran will allow nuclear inspectors back into the country
items.description: The US vice-president says a great deal of progress has been made after the first round of talks between the US and Iran.

items.title: At least 13 killed and dozens injured after Qatar gas explosion
items.description: The city's main liquified natural gas (LNG) processing site suffered a "technical accident" in the Ras Laffan industrial zone.

items.title: Myanmar army killed over 700 civilians in six months, UN says
items.description: The new UN report says the 702 civilian deaths over six months last year included 153 children.

items.title: Largest ever cocaine bust in Australia after police raid underground bunker
items.description: Police seized 2.7 tonnes of cocaine worth an estimated A$816m after searching a property in western Sydney.

items.title: Russian troop build-up threatens city seen as key to seizing Ukraine's Donbas
items.description: If Kostyantynivka falls, Russian forces would be able push towards Ukraine's last remaining strongholds in the east.

items.title: Guinea bans exports of raw gold to boost local refining
items.description: The prohibition is intended to boost the country's economy by refining gold domestically.

items.title: Schools close as more than half of France under red heat alerts
items.description: The health minister warns many citizens "will suffer", with temperatures set to peak on Monday.
